I join when operations, commerce, or science have outgrown their systems — and I ship both the product people will use and the AI platform underneath it.

This site is the SYSTEMS catalog: Kitchen Kontrol, NeuroNote, Tokyo Eye, Canon Forge, the Azure MLOps factory, and the AI/ML Engineer Academy. Two resume cuts share that spine — product leader, and GenAI/ML architect. LinkedIn currently wears the architect headline.
